'''Divo''' was a strong, [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a squat power-lifter and a student of [[Nova Stihl]]'s [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] lessons onboard the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had a tendency to ask more questions in the class than anyone else.<ref name="Death Star" />
